title: SeeDream 4.5
description: ByteDance SeeDream 4.5 — text-to-image, plus image editing and multi-reference composition from up to 9 reference images. Strong aesthetics, 2K/4K output.

max_images.description: Ceiling for grouped generation when sequential_image_generation is "auto": the model returns up to this many related images and decides the exact count (not guaranteed to be exactly this many). You are billed per image returned.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

reference_images.description: Optional reference images (up to 9) for image editing and multi-reference composition. Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Omit for text-to-image.

sequential_image_generation.description: Set to "auto" to return a group of related images (up to max_images); "disabled" (default) returns a single image.
